comments.body:
I got error "You are not allowed to view the requested page." when accessing https://www.pivotaltracker.com/story/show/81482904, so I can't read the original ticket for this task. But from the PR above, I think the following hardcoded fields should be retrieved from Spring configuration, the oaiProviderService bean in oai.xml:
id.setProtocolVersion("2.0");
id.setRepositoryName("Fedora 4");
id.getAdminEmail().add(0,"admin@example.com");
...
desc.setAny(new JAXBElement<String>(new QName("general"), String.class, "An example repository description"));

I see another constant value "INSTALL_DATE" in code id.setEarliestDatestamp("INSTALL_DATE"). Do you know what's the text INSTALL_DATE mean here?

I'll create a new PR for this ticket but I see some conflicts with my works in https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1237, so I'll start this task once the PR in ticket FCREPO-1237 Closed is merged.
See attached screenshots of original Pivotal Ticket.
I can guess what the INSTALL_DATE means, but frank asseg wrote the code.

Andrew Woods, I've fixed the mistake on setting the protocol version property, and updated to register the "oai" namespace only when it's not registered. Also the change for testing of the project version property that is set in oai.xml during maven build is included. See https://github.com/lsitu/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/commit/f786cb7e57adead42d62336f25a2c9d9231a4c5c
